The spreadsheet calculations failed because target cells in the 'Task' sheet returned 'None' instead of the expected numeric values.
Tests 'test_lookup_blocks' and 'test_derived_values_and_stats' failed at cells H12 and H35, which returned None instead of 612.5 and 4.5 respectively. This indicates a failure in the INDEX(MATCH, MATCH) formulas, likely due to misalignment between the 'Task' sheet series codes and the 'Data' sheet layout. Future steps must verify the exact row/column coordinates of series codes and year headers in the 'Data' sheet.
